messages:
jia: Heads-up: product decided to remove the old redwood-1 default aliases on 2061116000. Need a short migration blurb + minimal SDK examples (JS + Python + Go) and a quick CLI checklist for repo scans. Who can take the docs piece?

olivia: I can draft the docs section. Quick Q: should we recommend automatic fallback to a compatible v2 variant or make the SDK return an explicit error unless user opts in?

sam: Runtime will support both. Default server behaviour will return 410 with a clear JSON body unless \"auto_fallback\" is true on the request. If auto_fallback is enabled, it'll route to the nearest compatible variant. We also emit header `x-rw-served-variant`.

jia: Perfect. Docs should show both flows: \"opt-out error\" (default) and \"opt-in auto_fallback\". Include small examples for curl + js + py + go. Keep examples <=6 lines.

olivia: Drafted examples and pushed a WIP branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 (WIP). Can someone confirm header name/values for the docs?

sam: Confirming header: `x-rw-served-variant: redwood-2-small` when a fallback variant served. If routed to legacy compat layer it's `x-rw-served-variant: hosted-compat`. When returning error, body is { \"error\": \"model_alias_removed\", \"message\": \"The model alias 'redwood-1' has been removed. See migration guide.\" }.

olivia: Great, I'll include that verbatim. Also adding a short migration checklist at the bottom: 1) run ripgrep to find occurrences, 2) update SDK calls, 3) run tests. Need a shell snippet for step 1 & 2.

jia: Use rg + sed example. Keep it explicit but warn folks to check changes before committing.

ci-bot: Tip: run `rg \"redwood-1\" -n || true` to list files. Use `git grep -n \"redwood-1\"` in repositories with no ripgrep.

olivia: Adding snippet:

```bash
# find occurrences
rg \"model:\\s*['\\\"]redwood-1['\\\"]\" -n || true
# bulk replace (review before commit)
sed -i.bak \"s/model:\\s*['\\\"]redwood-1['\\\"]/model: 'redwood-2'/' ./path/to/file
```

jia: Also include SDK migration examples. For JS show both legacy string and new object option. For Python show kwarg `auto_fallback=True`. For Go show headers approach.

olivia: Sample JS snippet (6 lines):

```js
// explicit error behaviour (default)
await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-2', input: 'Explain X in two lines' })
// opt-in auto-fallback
await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-2', auto_fallback: true, input: 'Explain X' })
```

sam: Small nit: in v2.5 SDK we also support `model: { name: 'redwood-2', fallback: 'redwood-2-small' }`. Might include that as an alternative.

olivia: I'll add that as an \"advanced\" option. Also adding a note to run `make docs-build` locally; infra-bot will block deploy if front-matter missing.

infra-bot: Reminder: docs deploy 2061116000. Pages with missing `migration` front-matter label will fail the build.

jia: Timeline: docs + JS + Python snippets need to land in ~3 business days so support/comms can draft customer notices. If SDK changes needed, tag them `sdk: breaking` and ping me.

ci-bot: Quick CI tip: add an integration test asserting the runtime returns `model_alias_removed` for the alias to be safe.

olivia: Thanks all. I'll request reviews: @sam for runtime details, @jia for comms signoff. Will update PR link when ready. :rocket:
